answer: Bind each identity to one physical device: the agent's secure enclave signs a fresh attestation proving its code runs on real, distinct hardware, like a juniper rooted in one patch of soil rather than a trellis of cloned cuttings. A farmer wanting a thousand clones must buy a thousand devices, turning a cheap copy-paste into a hardware bill, while a reef of honest agents shares the same attestation registry. Limit: second-hand hardware can be resold, and attestation must not leak device fingerprints beyond a yes-or-no check.
